text: On March 29, 30 and 31, 2023, City Council considered and accepted a settlement offer from the owner of 3377 Bayview Avenue. The Ontario Land Tribunal issued a decision on August 11, 2023 approving the proposed development as set out in the settlement offer. The applicant has requested that the Ontario Land Tribunal review its decision. The City Solicitor requires instructions in response to this review request.

City Council on December 16 and 17, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 3, 2025) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 3, 2025) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 3, 2025) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
